prompt: [Context: User created a text badge labeled 'JavaScript'.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Displaying a list of user skills? Loop through their profile tags. -->
- [RepeatingContainer] source={{ [#] profile().skills }} item_alias="skill"
  - [Text] "{{ [abc] skill.name }}"

prompt: [Context: User added a repeating container of cart items.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: You'll want to display the order total at the bottom. -->
- [VBlock]
  - [RepeatingContainer] source={{ [#] cart().items }} item_alias="item"
    - [Text] "{{ [abc] item.name }}"
  - [HBlock]
    - [Text] "Order Total:"
    - [PriceDisplay] -> {{ [$] cart().totalPrice }}
  - [Button] "Checkout" -> trigger(cart().checkout())

prompt: [Context: User added a TextInput for FirstName and a TextInput for LastName.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Bind these to the user state to update their profile. -->
- [VBlock]
  - [TextInput] "First Name" -> {{ [abc] user().firstName }}
  - [TextInput] "Last Name" -> {{ [abc] user().lastName }}
  - [Text] "Preview: {{ [abc] user().firstName }} {{ [abc] user().lastName }}"

prompt: [Context: User added a DateInput for 'Date of Birth'.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Displaying their calculated age next to it? -->
- [HBlock]
  - [DateInput] "DOB" -> {{ [abc] user().dob }}
  - [Text] "Age: {{ [#] user().calculatedAge }}"

prompt: [Context: User added a Toggle for 'Is Public Profile'.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Add conditional helper text indicating visibility. -->
- [VBlock]
  - [HBlock]
    - [Text] "Public Profile"
    - [Toggle] -> {{ [⭘] user().isPublic }}
  - [Text] "Status: {{ [abc] user().visibilityStatusText }}"

prompt: [Context: User added a NumberInput bound to 'item.quantity'.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Add increment and decrement buttons around it. -->
- [HBlock]
  - [Button] "-" -> trigger(item().decrement())
  - [NumberInput] "Qty" -> {{ [#] item.quantity }}
  - [Button] "+" -> trigger(item().increment())

prompt: [Context: User added a TextInput bound to 'search.query'.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Add a clear button and show result count. -->
- [VBlock]
  - [HBlock]
    - [TextInput] "Search" -> {{ [abc] search().query }}
    - [Button] "Clear" -> trigger(search().clear())
  - [Text] "Found {{ [#] search().resultCount }} items"

prompt: [Context: User added a TextInput for Email and a Submit button.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Add a validation error message state below the input. -->
- [VBlock]
  - [TextInput] "Email" -> {{ [abc] form().email }}
  - [Text] "{{ [abc] form().emailError }}"
  - [Button] "Submit" -> trigger(form().submit())

prompt: [Context: User added a PasswordInput bound to 'signup.password'.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Add a 'Confirm Password' field for registration. -->
- [VBlock]
  - [PasswordInput] "Password" -> {{ [abc] signup().password }}
  - [PasswordInput] "Confirm Password" -> {{ [abc] signup().confirmPassword }}
  - [Text] "{{ [abc] signup().passwordMatchError }}"

prompt: [Context: User added a 1-5 rating input bound to 'review.stars'.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Show the global average rating above the input. -->
- [VBlock]
  - [Text] "Average Rating: {{ [#] product().averageRating }} / 5"
  - [NumberInput] "Your Rating" -> {{ [#] review().stars }}

prompt: [Context: User placed a Text element 'Step 1 of 3'.]
target_ir:
<!-- 💡 Tip: Add navigation controls for the multi-step form. -->
- [HBlock]
  - [Button] "Back" -> trigger(form().previousStep())
  - [Text] "Step {{ [#] form().currentStep }} of {{ [#] form().totalSteps }}"
  - [Button] "Next" -> trigger(form().nextStep())
